name: TPT Status Report
description: Lists Patients that had a TPT status during the selected period

config.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT patient_id
FROM (SELECT person_id AS patient_id
      FROM obs
      WHERE concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '7913502b-68ff-4e2b-ad64-82cb3f12ee2b')
        AND obs_datetime IS NOT NULL
        AND obs_datetime >= :startDate
        AND obs_datetime <= :endDate
        AND value_text IS NOT NULL
        AND voided = 0
      UNION ALL
      SELECT person_id AS patient_id
      FROM obs
      WHERE concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '37d4ac43-b3b4-4445-b63b-e3acf47c8910')
        AND obs_datetime IS NOT NULL
        AND obs_datetime >= :startDate
        AND obs_datetime <= :endDate
        AND value_coded IS NOT NULL
        AND voided = 0) tpt_status

SELECT DATE(value_datetime) FROM obs WHERE concept_id = 99161 AND person_id = :patientId AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT cn.name FROM concept_name cn WHERE cn.concept_id = o.value_coded AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND cn.voided = 0) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid IN ('dd2b0b4d-30ab-102d-86b0-7a5022ba4115', '97c48198-3cf7-4892-a3e6-d61fb1125882')) AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DATE(obs_datetime) FROM obs WHERE concept_id = 856 AND person_id = :patientId AND obs_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT value_numeric FROM obs WHERE concept_id = 856 AND person_id = :patientId AND obs_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT value_numeric FROM obs WHERE concept_id = 856 AND person_id = :patientId AND obs_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1) < 1000 THEN 'Suppressed' ELSE 'Not Suppressed' END

SELECT DATE(value_datetime) FROM obs WHERE concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '162933AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA') AND person_id = :patientId AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE(value_datetime) FROM obs WHERE concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '162934AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA') AND person_id = :patientId AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs WHERE concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '162934AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA') AND person_id = :patientId AND value_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1) THEN 'Completed' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs WHERE concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '162933AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA') AND person_id = :patientId AND value_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1) THEN 'On TPT' ELSE 'Not on TPT' END

SELECT (SELECT cn.name FROM concept_name cn WHERE cn.concept_id = o.value_coded AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND cn.voided = 0) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '73312fee-c321-11e8-a355-529269fb1459') AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE(o.value_datetime) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '73312fee-c321-11e8-a355-529269fb1459') AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1
